source.extraction: osmium 1.19.1 getid --add-referenced --remove-tags for the 24 explicitly listed way IDs; export --geometry-types=linestring --stop-on-error --attributes=type,id,version,timestamp. Complete source coordinates, without simplification or clipping to a region.

seams.basis: The reviewed PCT–South Fork Agnes correction and named Cloudy Pass/Emerald Park southern crossings. This fixture checks their union coverage, not that all of each way belongs to North.
All 16 PCT ways explicitly used for the Norse Peak–Stampede Pass corridor that closed the historical 18.8 km coverage gap.
The explicitly identified PCT and Klickitat seam ways. Blue Lake–Hamilton trail IDs were not recorded in the charter, so this fixture does not claim to cover that entire component.

limitations: These are selected historical seam regressions, not a statewide continuity, trail completeness, legal-access, elevation, or generated-route proof.
Named areas select starts; each complete source line must also fit at least one independent routing envelope. No stitching is implied.
Original source tags are retained as evidence, not current authority. South Fork Agnes way/1346658204 has bad visibility and an unresolved survey/ford note.

intentionalExclusions.basis: The current explicit Yakama product exclusion intersects these zero-based source segments. They remain unavailable in start and routing geometry. Coverage assertions apply only to the remaining line; this is not a connected through-route claim or a new access decision.
